/* ============================================================
   Serverless SQL Pool - Capa Gold: tablas externas (CETAS)
   Basado en las vistas gold.* que leen del contenedor silver.

   Requisitos previos: cred_ABL, source_gold, format_parquet
   y el esquema [gold] deben existir.

   IMPORTANTE: cada carpeta indicada en LOCATION NO debe existir
   antes de ejecutar. El CETAS la crea.
   ============================================================ */


--------------------------------------
-- CALENDAR  (vista: gold.calendar)
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.extcalendar
WITH
(
    LOCATION    = 'external calendar',
    DATA_SOURCE = source_gold,
    FILE_FORMAT = format_parquet
)
AS
SELECT * FROM gold.calendar;
GO

--------------------------------------
-- CUSTOMER  (vista: gold.Customer -- singular)
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.extcustomer
WITH
(
    LOCATION    = 'external customer',
    DATA_SOURCE = source_gold,
    FILE_FORMAT = format_parquet
)
AS
SELECT * FROM gold.Customer;
GO

--------------------------------------

WITH
(
    LOCATION    = 'external returns',

SELECT * FROM gold.Retur;
